description: This file defines the MethodResolver interface used for executing methods on String or Object targets within a substitution engine, including support checks and argument handling.

classes.name: MethodResolver
classes.description: Interface for resolving and executing methods on String or Object targets for substitution purposes.

methods.name: supportsMethod
methods.description: Checks if the resolver can handle a specific method for a given target class.

methods.name: getArgCount
methods.description: Determines the number of arguments required for a method.

methods.name: executeMethod
methods.description: Executes a method on a String target with optional arguments.

methods.name: executeMethod
methods.description: Executes a method on an Object target with optional arguments.
